description:
About the Position

The Department of Bioengineering at Imperial College London, under the supervision of Dr. Dandan Zhang, is offering a fully funded PhD position focusing on AI-driven 3D ultrasound imaging and autonomous robotic guidance. This position is part of the Multi-Scale Embodied Intelligence (MSEI) Lab which pioneers trustworthy embodied AI for healthcare applications.

Funding & Benefits

  • Tuition Fees: Full coverage (UK/EU and international rates) for 3.5-4 years
  • Stipend: £21,000 - £23,000 per year (tax-free) for 3.5-4 years
  • Research Costs: £5,000+ per year for conference travel and equipment
  • Health Insurance: Access to NHS healthcare
  • Industry collaborations and internships available

Research Focus

  • Medical Robotics: Developing robotic systems for surgical assistance
  • AI-Driven Imaging: Creating machine learning algorithms for medical image analysis
  • Autonomous Systems: Building robots that can operate with minimal human intervention
  • 3D Ultrasound: Advanced imaging techniques for real-time medical diagnostics
  • Embodied Intelligence: Integrating AI with physical robotic systems

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Academic Background: First-class or upper second-class honours degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or related field
  • Master's Degree: Master's degree (or equivalent) in relevant field (preferred)
  • Research Experience: Demonstrated experience in medical imaging, robotics, or machine learning
  • English Proficiency: IELTS 6.5+ (with no component below 6.0) or equivalent

Application Process

  1. Contact Dr. Zhang with CV and research proposal.
  2. Submit PhD application to Imperial College.
  3. Shortlisting process.
  4. Interview with selection panel.
  5. Funding decision.
  6. Begin PhD program.

Required Documents

  • CV/Resume highlighting academic and research experience
  • Research Proposal (2-3 pages)
  • Transcripts (all undergraduate and graduate records)
  • Two Academic References
  • English Proficiency Scores (IELTS or TOEFL if applicable)

Timeline & Deadlines

StageDate
Application OpensOctober 2026
Scholarship DeadlineJanuary 2027
Interview PeriodFebruary-March 2027
Decision NotificationApril 2027
Program StartSeptember/October 2027

Official Link

https://www.imperial.ac.uk/bioengineering

Important Notes

  • Imperial College is ranked #8 globally for Engineering and Technology.
  • Work at the intersection of AI and medical robotics for healthcare impact.
  • Direct collaboration with clinical partners for real-world application.
  • Technical requirements: Python, C++, MATLAB, deep learning frameworks, ROS.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

About Imperial College London

Imperial College London is a public research university focused on science, engineering, medicine and business. Based in London, it offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in these fields. Its academic community combines scientific research with practical applications, working with healthcare, industry and international partners on technological and societal challenges worldwide.

Official website: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
